name: mx000-studio
description: Offline browser editor for the TC Electronic M3000 and M2000, built on MIDI Studio.

scripts.prebuild: npm run modules:generate && node scripts/build-tc-m3000-map.mjs --check && node scripts/build-tc-m2000-map.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-tc-m3000-preview.mjs --check
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/verify-distribution.mjs dist
scripts.maps:generate: node scripts/build-tc-m3000-map.mjs && node scripts/build-tc-m2000-map.mjs && node scripts/generate-tc-m3000-preview.mjs
